description.en: Open, save, reopen, and version native Design Files without treating chat as document state.
description.zh-CN: 打开、保存、重开并版本化原生设计文件，聊天记录不充当设计事实。

capabilities.provider: OpenDesign Workspace + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: The Agent can create, rename, duplicate, reorder, clear, and delete Pages through an explicit Page or Design File mutation target, but it cannot manage Projects or Design Files.
limitations.zh-CN: Agent 可通过显式 Page 或 Design File 写入目标创建、重命名、复制、排序、清空和删除 Page，但尚不能管理 Project 或 Design File。

description.en: Pan, zoom, hit test, box-select, multi-select, traverse hierarchy with Figma-compatible Canvas/Layers/keyboard selection, and transform persistent objects on the production Leafer canvas.
description.zh-CN: 在生产 Leafer 画布中平移、缩放、命中、框选、多选，通过兼容 Figma 的 Canvas/Layers/键盘统一选区遍历层级，并变换持久对象。

capabilities.provider: @opendesign/leafer-engine / leafer-editor@2.2.9

limitations.en: Real Electron pan/zoom/edit-box stability and high-node-count performance are not yet accepted on macOS and Windows.
limitations.zh-CN: macOS 与 Windows 上的真实 Electron 平移、缩放、选框稳定性和大节点量性能尚未完成验收。

description.en: Create and inspect semantic Frames, Groups, nested layers, visibility, locking, sibling stacking order, cross-container reparenting, and ordered transactions; human commands and the Agent share the same hierarchy planners.
description.zh-CN: 创建并检查语义化 Frame、Group、嵌套图层、可见性、锁定、兄弟图层堆叠顺序、跨容器重挂载和有序事务；人工命令与 Agent 共用同一套层级 planner。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.39.0 + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: Automatic Canvas parenting remains incomplete; explicit cross-container reparenting in the Layers panel is currently pointer-driven.
limitations.zh-CN: 画布直接操作时的自动归属仍未补齐；图层面板中的显式跨容器重挂载目前以指针拖放为主。

limitations.en: Ungrouping explicitly rejects Group-level visibility, opacity, blend, effects, or masks that cannot be preserved without changing rendered output.
limitations.zh-CN: 当 Group 级可见性、不透明度、混合、效果或蒙版无法在解组后保持视觉一致时，解组会明确拒绝。

description.en: Align multiple layers, distribute horizontal or vertical gaps with fixed outer anchors, set exact positive, zero, or negative one-dimensional spacing, and Tidy up rows, columns, or unequal/sparse two-dimensional grids through shared human and Agent planners.
description.zh-CN: 通过人工 UI 与 Agent 共用的 planner 对齐多层对象、固定两端均分横向或纵向间隙、设置正数/零/负数的一维精确间距，并整理行、列或不等尺寸/稀疏二维网格。

capabilities.provider: @opendesign/geometry-service contract v4 + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: Single-layer alignment to its parent, Smart Selection canvas spacing handles and reflow editing, flip/origin controls, snapping, guides, rulers, and pixel-grid rounding remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 单层相对父级对齐、Smart Selection 画布间距手柄与回流编辑、翻转/原点、吸附、参考线、标尺和像素网格取整仍未补齐。

limitations.en: The arrangement product path remains intentionally separate from the isolated PathKit vector provider; no vector product capability is implied here.
limitations.zh-CN: 排列产品链与隔离的 PathKit 矢量 provider 保持明确分离；本能力不据此宣称任何矢量产品能力。

label.en: Editable paths, Pen, and point editing
label.zh-CN: 可编辑 Path、Pen 与节点编辑

description.en: Create editable cubic contours with Pen, refine existing vertices and Bézier handles, or preserve exact SVG path data, then render all forms through one Path projection.
description.zh-CN: 使用 Pen 创建可编辑三次曲线轮廓、继续调整已有节点和贝塞尔手柄，或精确保留 SVG Path 数据，并通过同一 Path 投影渲染。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 + Geometry Service contract v13 point/path selection-delete/transform/Connect/Disconnect/Cut + EditorRuntime document-space multi-Vector planner + Leafer Pen/point/path/Lasso/shared-transform/Cut overlay + controlled SVG metadata v2

limitations.en: Pen supports click vertices, click-drag mirrored cubic handles, first-point closure, Enter/Escape open completion, Backspace rollback, tool-switch completion, tight bounds, and one undoable transaction. It currently authors one non-branching contour.
limitations.zh-CN: Pen 已支持点击放点、拖拽镜像三次曲线手柄、首点闭合、Enter/Escape 完成开放路径、Backspace 回退、切换工具收尾、精确 bounds 和单次可撤销事务；当前只创建单条非分叉轮廓。

limitations.en: Enter or double-click opens point editing for one or more selected Vector layers containing non-branching contours. Every layer keeps its own trace, stable point/path selection, and read-only state. Q Lasso selects fully enclosed points and line/cubic segments; Delete reconnects removed vertices but truly breaks selected segments into deterministic open runs. Any two or more selected points across the edit collection share one document-space move/eight-way-resize/rotation box; resize or rotation can hold Space to reposition and then resume without a jump. Pointer-up and Agent document-space transforms commit all changed layers in one revision/undo.
limitations.zh-CN: Enter 或双击可让一个或多个已选 Vector 图层进入非分支多轮廓节点编辑；每层拥有独立 trace、稳定 point/path 选区和只读状态。Q 套索可圈选完整包含的节点与 line/cubic segment；Delete 对节点执行重连，对 segment 则真实断开并确定性生成开放 runs。编辑集合中任意两个以上节点共用一个 document-space 移动/八向缩放/旋转框；缩放或旋转中按住 Space 可平移选区，松开后无跳变继续原操作。pointer-up 与 Agent document-space 变换都把所有变化层提交为一次 revision/undo。

limitations.en: Cut mode (X) creates true point/segment breaks and finite document-space divisions across multiple Vector layers. Closed boundaries use same-side connectors and continuous boundary stitching for crossed holes and concave multi-intersection components; open contours split at every transverse crossing into alternating retained/extracted open path runs without connectors, regions, or implicit fill. Point/path Lasso, segment Delete, same-Vector Connect/Disconnect, shared cross-Vector point transforms, and Space reposition use stable topology and atomic gestures. Segment Bend/per-segment appearance, nested/overlapping regions, direct hole-only cuts, cross-layer Connect, branching networks, flatten, outline stroke, pixel baselines, and packaged interaction evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Cut 模式（X）支持节点/路径真实断点和跨多个 Vector 图层的有限 document-space 分割；闭合边界通过同侧 connector 与连续边界缝合处理穿孔和凹形多交点 component，开放 contour 按每个真实横穿交点拆成 retained/extracted 开放 runs，不补 connector、region 或隐式 Fill。point/path Lasso、segment Delete、同一 Vector Connect/Disconnect、跨 Vector 统一节点变换与 Space 中途平移共用稳定拓扑和原子手势。segment Bend/per-segment appearance、嵌套/重叠 region、只切孔洞、跨层 Connect、分支网络、flatten、outline stroke、像素基线和打包交互证据仍未完成。

limitations.en: Controlled OpenDesign SVG metadata preserves schema-valid editable networks only when it exactly matches the standard rendered path. External SVG without metadata remains exact path data rather than guessed editable topology.
limitations.zh-CN: 受控 OpenDesign SVG metadata 只在通过 schema、拓扑且与标准渲染 path 精确匹配时保留 editable network；没有 metadata 的外部 SVG 保持为精确 path 数据，不猜测可编辑拓扑。

description.en: Create and directly edit directed straight lines with independent start and end decorations, professional stroke controls, and editable SVG interchange.
description.zh-CN: 创建并直接编辑有方向的直线，独立设置起终点装饰和专业描边，并通过 SVG 保持可编辑交换。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 + Leafer Arrow / LineEditTool + SVG controlled markers

limitations.en: This slice supports one editable straight segment, Shift 45-degree constraint, Alt center drawing, independent none/line-arrow/triangle/reversed-triangle/circle/diamond endpoints, cap/join/dash controls, and native endpoint dragging. Polyline connectors, orthogonal routing, snapping, label attachment, and packaged macOS/Windows interaction evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 当前切片支持单段可编辑直线、Shift 45 度约束、Alt 中心绘制、独立的无/线性箭头/三角/反向三角/圆点/菱形端点、端帽/连接/虚线控制和原生端点拖动；折线连接器、正交路由、吸附、标签挂接及 macOS/Windows 打包交互证据仍未完成。

limitations.en: SVG round-trip uses exact local OpenDesign marker definitions. Plain external line elements import as Lines, while unknown, external, missing, or modified marker definitions fail explicitly instead of being flattened or trusted.
limitations.zh-CN: SVG 往返使用精确的本地 OpenDesign marker 定义；普通外部 line 可导入为 Line，未知、外部、缺失或被修改的 marker 会明确失败，不会被扁平化或盲目信任。

description.en: Create, resize, restyle, and exchange semantic regular Polygon and Star nodes without flattening them into generic paths.
description.zh-CN: 创建、缩放、调整外观并交换语义化 Polygon 与 Star 节点，不将其扁平化为普通 Path。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 + Leafer Polygon/Star + controlled SVG regular-shape metadata

limitations.en: Polygon supports 3–60 points; Star supports 3–60 points and a normalized inner radius. Shift constrains the draw bounds to a square and Alt/Option draws from the center. Leafer cornerRadius renders live rounded shapes, but Figma-style corner smoothing is not yet part of the OpenDesign contract.
limitations.zh-CN: Polygon 支持 3–60 个顶点；Star 支持 3–60 个顶点和归一化内径。Shift 将绘制边界约束为正方形，Alt/Option 从中心绘制。Leafer cornerRadius 可渲染实时圆角图形，但 Figma 式 corner smoothing 尚未进入 OpenDesign 协议。

limitations.en: Sharp Polygon/Star nodes participate in deterministic Boolean geometry and exact controlled SVG round-trip. Rounded regular shapes fail Boolean creation and SVG export explicitly until an exact rounded outline exists; ordinary external SVG polygons continue to import as Vectors instead of being guessed as semantic shapes.
limitations.zh-CN: 零圆角 Polygon/Star 可参与确定性 Boolean geometry，并通过受控 SVG 精确往返。圆角规则图形在精确 outline 完成前会明确拒绝 Boolean 创建与 SVG 导出；普通外部 SVG polygon 继续导入为 Vector，不猜测为语义图形。

limitations.en: Packaged macOS/Windows direct-manipulation evidence and real Leafer pixel baselines are not yet recorded.
limitations.zh-CN: 尚未记录 macOS/Windows 打包程序的直接操作证据与真实 Leafer 像素基线。

description.en: Create and refine open, closed, branching, and curved vector geometry using points and Bézier handles.
description.zh-CN: 通过节点和贝塞尔手柄创建、编辑开放、闭合、分支与曲线矢量几何。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 Vector Network + Geometry Service contract v13 point/path selection-delete/transform/Connect/Disconnect/Cut + EditorRuntime document-space multi-Vector planner + Leafer native overlays

limitations.en: Pen authors one non-branching contour. Existing-node editing supports multi-Vector collections, Open/Close/Reverse, Connect/Disconnect, point/path Lasso and segment Delete, one shared document-space transform box across selected points, Space reposition during resize/rotation, and click/document-space Cut. Segment Bend/per-segment appearance, nested/overlapping regions, direct hole-only cuts, branching networks, flatten, outline stroke, and packaged evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Pen 当前创建单条非分支轮廓；已有节点编辑支持多 Vector collection、Open/Close/Reverse、Connect/Disconnect、point/path Lasso 与 segment Delete、跨所选节点的统一 document-space 变换框、缩放/旋转中 Space 平移，以及点击/document-space Cut。segment Bend/per-segment appearance、嵌套/重叠 region、只切孔洞、分支网络、flatten、outline stroke 与打包证据仍未完成。

description.en: Non-destructive union, subtract, intersect, and exclude groups whose source layers remain editable.
description.zh-CN: 非破坏性的 union、subtract、intersect 与 exclude，且源图层保持可编辑。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 + EditorRuntime Boolean planner + recursive Skia PathKit resolver + Leafer derived projection

limitations.en: The recursive resolver converts Rectangle, Ellipse, sharp Polygon/Star, Path, Vector, and nested Boolean operands into fill-plus-stroke PathKit geometry, applies local transforms, preserves honest empty results, and projects a stable synthetic Leafer Path without persisting provider output.
limitations.zh-CN: 递归 resolver 会把 Rectangle、Ellipse、零圆角 Polygon/Star、Path、Vector 与嵌套 Boolean 转换为包含 fill+stroke 的 PathKit 几何，应用局部 transform、保留真实空结果，并在不持久化 provider 输出的前提下投影稳定的 Leafer synthetic Path。

limitations.en: The toolbar/menu, macOS and Windows shortcuts, Inspector operation control, ungroup command, and typed Agent hierarchy actions reuse the same previewed atomic planners. Enter, double-click, layer-tree selection, Shift+Enter, Escape, and Tab provide transient source-operand editing with live derived-result preview, locked read-only state, controlled appearance fields, and contextual failure recovery. Text outlines, SVG round-trip, pixel baselines, and macOS/Windows packaged product evidence remain unavailable. Dash patterns longer than two values, masked operands, and non-center strokes on open paths fail explicitly instead of being approximated.
limitations.zh-CN: 工具栏/菜单、macOS 与 Windows 快捷键、Inspector operation 控件、解组命令和 Agent hierarchy typed actions 已复用同一套经过 preview 的原子 planner。Enter、双击、图层树选择、Shift+Enter、Escape 与 Tab 已提供短生命周期的源 operand 编辑、派生结果实时预览、锁定只读状态、受控外观字段和上下文失败恢复。文字轮廓、SVG 往返、像素基线和 macOS/Windows 打包产品证据仍不可用；超过两段的 dash pattern、带 mask 的 operand 和开放路径的非居中描边会明确失败，不做静默近似。

description.en: Apply multiple paints and strokes, gradients, shadows, glows, blur, blend modes, masks, and advanced stroke properties.
description.zh-CN: 应用多重填充与描边、渐变、阴影、光晕、模糊、混合模式、蒙版和高级描边。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.10.0 + EditorRuntime mask planner + PropertiesPanel + Leafer adapter + SVG filter/mask adapter

limitations.en: Figma-style authoring now creates one contained sibling mask atomically from supported Shape, Text, Image, or container sources, exposes Alpha/Vector/Luminance to people and Agent tools, and preserves editable content through undo and save. The editable SVG boundary preserves its controlled alpha/luminance/outline/clipping runs. Image/Text SVG mask sources, arbitrary combined mask graphs, mask-outline canvas view, inner/background effects, Electron visual baselines, and professional color picking remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Figma-style 作者工作流现可从受支持的 Shape、Text、Image 或容器 source 原子创建 contained sibling mask，人工与 Agent 均使用 Alpha/Vector/Luminance，并在 undo/save 后保持内容可编辑；可编辑 SVG 边界继续保留其受控 alpha/luminance/outline/clipping 段。Image/Text SVG 蒙版源、任意组合 mask graph、画布蒙版轮廓视图、内/背景效果、Electron 视觉基线和专业取色仍未完成。

description.en: Read explicit image references, paste or drop images, generate raster artwork, and place content-addressed assets on the canvas.
description.zh-CN: 读取明示图片引用、粘贴或拖放图片、生成位图素材，并把内容寻址 asset 放入画布。

capabilities.provider: AgentAttachmentHost + ImageGenerationHost + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: Image generation requires separate global configuration. Current-file image assets now support preview, search, usage, location, canvas drag placement, import, file-wide replacement/relink, and safe deletion; fonts, cross-file libraries, provenance, background removal, large-list virtualization, and native macOS/Windows interaction evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 图片生成需要独立全局配置；当前文件图片资源已支持预览、搜索、使用次数、定位、画布拖放、导入、全文件替换/relink 与安全删除，但字体、跨文件 Library、来源谱系、移除背景、大列表虚拟化及 macOS/Windows 原生交互证据仍未完成。

description.en: Crop and adjust non-destructively, preserve source history, restore image variants, and replace sources without overwriting the original.
description.zh-CN: 非破坏性裁剪与调整，保留来源历史、恢复图片变体，并在不覆盖原图的情况下替换来源。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.42.0 + OpenDesign Image Service contract 3 + recoverable image derivation DAG + Leafer per-image-paint adjustment projection

limitations.en: Image nodes and each image Fill/Stroke support Figma-compatible adjustments through one deterministic RGBA projection. Source replacement now records a recoverable typed derivation family shared by Inspector, Assets, Agent, undo, and persistence. Remote AI editing providers, large-image on-demand storage, standalone cross-file Image Paint Style asset bundles, SVG raster embedding, complete Figma imageHash/transform file adapters, color-managed P3/ICC output, and native macOS/Windows interaction evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Image 节点及每项图片 Fill/Stroke 已通过同一确定性 RGBA 投影支持 Figma-compatible 调整；来源替换会记录由 Inspector、Assets、Agent、undo 与持久化共用的可恢复 typed derivation family。远端 AI 图片编辑 provider、大图按需存储、standalone 跨文件 Image Paint Style asset bundle、SVG 位图嵌入、完整 Figma imageHash/transform 文件 adapter、P3/ICC 色彩管理及 macOS/Windows 原生交互证据仍未完成。

description.en: Create traced variants from one or more source images using masks, inpainting, outpainting, background replacement, relighting, or style harmonization.
description.zh-CN: 基于一张或多张源图，通过蒙版、局部重绘、扩图、背景替换、重打光或风格统一生成可追溯变体。

capabilities.provider: OpenDesign Image Service contract 4 + Main-owned RGBA mask generation + ImageGenerationHost openai-images edit adapter + EditorRuntime recoverable derivation planner

limitations.en: Embedded PNG, JPEG, and WebP Image nodes support background removal, full-image prompt editing with one optional reference, and canvas-lasso Erase/Isolate through the global openai-images service. Prompted local repainting, expansion, background replacement, relighting, style harmonization, Image Paint editing, and multiple references remain unavailable.
limitations.zh-CN: 内嵌 PNG、JPEG 与 WebP Image 节点已可通过全局 openai-images 服务去背景、用提示词和一张可选参考图编辑整图，并通过画布 lasso 执行 Erase/Isolate；带提示词的局部重绘、扩图、背景替换、重打光、风格统一、Image Paint 编辑与多参考图仍未完成。

description.en: Create, render, transform, and edit fixed, Auto Width, or Auto Height text with one shared font style, alignment, explicit wrapping, and fixed-box overflow controls.
description.zh-CN: 创建、渲染、变换和编辑固定、自动宽度或自动高度文字，使用单一共享字体样式、对齐、明确换行以及固定框溢出控制。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.33.0 + Text Layout Service v4 + leafer-editor@2.2.9 Text/TextEditor + controlled SVG text metadata v8

limitations.en: Exact family/style-name/weight/slant identity, runtime font availability, exact file-wide replacement, explicit Auto Size reflow, and unresolved Figma export failure are available through one revision/undo. Font binary assets, variable-font axes, exact cross-platform shaping, and macOS/Windows visual acceptance remain unavailable.
limitations.zh-CN: family/style-name/weight/slant 精确身份、运行时字体可用性、全文件精确替换、显式 Auto Size 重排及 unresolved Figma 导出失败已通过单次 revision/undo 可用；字体二进制资源、可变字体轴、精确跨平台 shaping 及 macOS/Windows 视觉验收仍未完成。

description.en: Author Figma-compatible UTF-16 character and paragraph runs through one revisioned Runtime, live range Inspector, Agent tools, native/HarfBuzz projection, and structured Figma/SVG/raster interchange.
description.zh-CN: 通过唯一版本化 Runtime、真实范围 Inspector、Agent 工具、native/HarfBuzz 投影及 Figma/SVG/位图结构往返创建 Figma-compatible UTF-16 字符与段落 runs。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.33.0 + Text Paragraph Service v2 / Text List Service v1 / Text Editing Session Service v2 / Text Run Layout v4 + leafer-editor 2.2.9 + harfbuzzjs 1.4.0 + SVG metadata v8

limitations.en: Rich runs cover exact face, size, tracking, line height, case, decoration, fills, optional Text/Paint Style IDs, paragraph-local indent/spacing, and semantic ordered/unordered lists with five indentation levels, list spacing, node-level hanging markers, deterministic nested counters, wrapped-line hanging indentation, and LTR/RTL logical-start projection. Text Editing Session v2 stages non-empty range edits and collapsed-caret typing styles, materializes styles only after real UTF-16 input, keeps a disposable edit-DOM marker out of content/history, preserves Inspector focus and IME DOM identity, and commits one commit_text_edit Runtime transaction/reflow/revision per editing session. Typed-prefix lists and structural keys remain available. Custom list markers, advanced decoration geometry, OpenType controls, variable axes, live propagation of local Style edits into bound ranges, font packaging/authorization transfer, text-on-path, newer bidi data, native IME/undo smoke, and packaged macOS/Windows visual evidence remain unavailable.
limitations.zh-CN: 富文本 runs 已覆盖精确 face、字号、字距、行高、大小写、装饰、fills、可选 Text/Paint Style ID、逐段 indent/spacing，以及语义化 ordered/unordered 列表、五级缩进、list spacing、节点级 hanging marker、确定性嵌套计数、换行 hanging indent 与 LTR/RTL logical-start 投影。Text Editing Session v2 会暂存非空范围修改和折叠光标输入样式，只在真实 UTF-16 输入后物化样式；可丢弃 edit-DOM marker 不进入 content/history，Inspector 焦点与 IME DOM identity 保持稳定，每次编辑 session 只提交一条 commit_text_edit Runtime transaction/reflow/revision。输入前缀列表与结构键继续可用。custom list marker、高级 decoration 几何、OpenType 控件、可变字体轴、本地 Style 修改向绑定 range 的实时传播、字体随文件打包/授权迁移、路径文字、更新 bidi 数据、原生 IME/undo smoke 和 macOS/Windows 打包视觉证据仍不可用。

description.en: Pin, stretch, center, or proportionally scale ordinary Frame children when their parent Frame is resized.
description.zh-CN: 父 Frame 调整尺寸时，将普通直属子层固定到边缘、拉伸、居中或按比例缩放。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.12.0 + @opendesign/layout-service contract v1 + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: Constraints v1 applies only to translation-only direct children of ordinary Frames. Auto Layout flow children use their parent flow instead of constraints. Groups and Boolean bounds, Instance resizing, Auto Size text stretching, and packaged macOS/Windows GUI evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Constraints v1 仅适用于普通 Frame 中无旋转/倾斜/局部缩放的直属子层；Auto Layout 流内子层改由父流管理，不再使用普通 constraints。Group/Boolean 边界、Instance resize、Auto Size 文字拉伸，以及 macOS/Windows 打包 GUI 实机证据仍未完成。

description.en: Lay out Frames responsively and add non-exported Uniform, Columns, or Rows Layout Guides without changing child geometry.
description.zh-CN: 响应式布局 Frame，并添加不改变 child 几何且不导出的 Uniform、Columns 或 Rows Layout Guide。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.35.0 Auto Layout Grid v2 + Layout Guide + @opendesign/layout-service Auto Layout contract v8 + EditorRuntime

limitations.en: Auto Layout Grid v2 supports explicit Fixed/Fill/Hug rows and columns, automatic Fill rows for row-major flow, independent gaps, Manual or row-major item positioning, child cell/span/alignment, span-aware row/column reordering with a complete movement map, deterministic Runtime reflow, Inspector, Agent and public Figma Plugin API projection. Uniform, Columns, and Rows Layout Guides remain non-layout visual aids. Automatic row templates beyond Fill, automatic columns, dense/column flow, guide styles/variables, snapping, counter-axis Auto gap, vertical wrap, Wrap+Fill, baseline, rotated absolute children, canvas cell drag handles, SVG Grid metadata, and packaged macOS/Windows GUI evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Auto Layout Grid v2 已支持显式 Fixed/Fill/Hug 行列轨道、row-major flow 自动增减 Fill 行、独立双 gap、Manual 或 row-major 排布、child cell/span/alignment、跨 span 的行列重排与完整 movement map、Runtime 确定回流、Inspector、Agent 与 Figma 公共 Plugin API 投影。Uniform、Columns 与 Rows Layout Guide 仍是不参与布局的视觉辅助。Fill 以外的自动行模板、自动列、dense/column flow、Guide style/变量、吸附、交叉轴 Auto gap、垂直 wrap、Wrap+Fill、baseline、旋转 absolute child、画布 cell 拖拽手柄、SVG Grid metadata，以及 macOS/Windows 打包 GUI 实机证据仍未完成。

description.en: Create main components, instances, nested instances, overrides, component properties, slots, and variant sets.
description.zh-CN: 创建主组件、实例、嵌套实例、override、组件属性、Slot 与 Variant Set。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.39.0 + @opendesign/component-service contract v6 + @opendesign/library-service contract v2 + isolated @opendesign/figma-interop

limitations.en: Same-file Main components, linked/nested instances, Figma-compatible properties, Component Sets, variants, Slots, overrides, projection, persistence, autosave, and history are implemented. Same-Project Design Files can publish immutable Component/Variant/Shared Style/Variable releases, explicitly enable them per consumer, place linked imported Instances, apply imported Styles and Variables, review updates, disable without breaking existing references, and persist the result through the same Runtime. Canvas, Layers, Inspector, and keyboard navigation share one Runtime selection; derived layers use session-only Instance plus stable source path, while unsafe derived transforms and destructive commands fail closed. Slot-in-Slot is intentionally rejected to match Figma's public composition model. Workspace/remote Libraries, publishing permissions, private .fig decoding, Plugin/REST import-export, complete derived direct manipulation, and packaged macOS/Windows GUI evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 已实现同一 Design File 内的 Main、链接/嵌套 Instance、Figma-compatible properties、Component Set、Variant、Slot、override、投影、持久化、autosave 和 history。同 Project 的 Design File 可发布不可变 Component/Variant/Shared Style/Variable release，由消费文件显式启用、放置链接 imported Instance、应用 imported Style/Variable、审阅更新、禁用且不破坏现有引用，并通过同一 Runtime 保存结果。Canvas、Layers、Inspector 与键盘导航共享唯一 Runtime selection；派生层只使用 session-only Instance 与稳定 source path，不安全的派生 transform 和危险命令失败封闭。Slot-in-Slot 按 Figma 公开 composition model 永久失败封闭；Workspace/远端 Library、发布权限、私有 .fig 解码、Plugin/REST 导入导出、完整派生直接操作和 macOS/Windows 打包 GUI 实机证据仍未完成。

description.en: Define typed variables, collections, modes, aliases, scopes, bindings, and deterministic mode switching.
description.zh-CN: 定义类型化 variable、collection、mode、alias、scope、binding 和确定性模式切换。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.39.0 + @opendesign/variable-service contract v1 + @opendesign/library-service contract v2 + isolated @opendesign/figma-interop

limitations.en: Variables bind BOOLEAN visibility, FLOAT opacity, STRING Text content, and COLOR SolidPaint color, including node paint bindings applied after Shared Style projection. Same-Project Libraries publish Variable-only releases and hidden alias dependencies; enabled consumers search Local/Library sources and import the Collection, alias closure, Variable, and binding in one transaction. Timing/Easing bindings, broader node/Paint and Style fields, gradients/effects, component-property bindings, prototype variables, extended collections, Workspace/remote Libraries, DTCG/REST/Plugin import-export, and packaged macOS/Windows GUI evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: Variables 已支持 BOOLEAN 可见性、FLOAT 不透明度、STRING 文本内容和 COLOR SolidPaint 颜色绑定，并可在 Shared Style 投影后应用节点 paint binding。同 Project Library 支持 Variable-only release 与隐藏 alias 依赖；消费文件启用后可搜索 Local/Library 来源，并以一笔事务导入 Collection、alias closure、Variable 和 binding。Timing/Easing 绑定、更多节点/Paint/Style 字段、渐变/效果、组件属性绑定、原型变量、扩展集合、Workspace/远端 Library、DTCG/REST/Plugin 导入导出及 macOS/Windows 打包 GUI 证据仍未完成。

description.en: Create and manage local Paint, Text, Effect, and Grid styles, then publish and consume them across Design Files in the same Project.
description.zh-CN: 创建并管理本地 Paint、Text、Effect 与 Grid 样式，并在同一 Project 的多个 Design File 之间发布和消费。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.39.0 + @opendesign/style-service contract v2 + @opendesign/library-service contract v2 + isolated @opendesign/figma-interop

limitations.en: Paint, Text, Effect, and Grid registries, stable per-type order, Figma-shaped node references, fallback-preserving detach/delete/direct edits, Component → Style → Variable projection, Local Styles UI, Inspector pickers, typed Agent operations, Leafer/SVG/raster, persistence, history, and bounded public Figma interop are implemented. Same-Project Library releases publish visible Styles plus hidden Component dependencies; consumers explicitly enable Libraries, search Local and Library Styles, import a source and reference in one transaction, review updates, and keep existing references when disabled. Workspace/remote Libraries, publishing permissions, Style suggestions, complete Figma payloads, private .fig decoding, bidirectional Plugin/REST import-export, and packaged macOS/Windows GUI evidence remain incomplete.
limitations.zh-CN: 已实现 Paint、Text、Effect、Grid registry、按类型稳定顺序、Figma-shaped 节点引用、解绑/删除/直接编辑时 fallback 保真、Component → Style → Variable 投影、Local Styles UI、Inspector picker、Agent typed 操作、Leafer/SVG/位图、持久化、history 与有界的 Figma 公共 interop。同 Project Library release 可发布可见 Styles 与 Component 所需隐藏依赖；消费文件显式启用 Library、搜索 Local/Library Styles、以单事务导入 source 并建立引用、审阅更新，禁用时保留现有引用。Workspace/远端 Library、发布权限、Style suggestions、完整 Figma payload、私有 .fig 解码、Plugin/REST 双向导入导出及 macOS/Windows 打包 GUI 证据仍未完成。

description.en: Import supported SVG structure, controlled editable Text, Frame clipping, masks, and basic filter effects as editable OpenDesign layers, and export the same supported semantics plus resolved Boolean results with explicit fidelity reporting.
description.zh-CN: 把受支持的 SVG 结构、受控可编辑 Text、Frame 裁剪、蒙版与基础滤镜效果导入为可编辑 OpenDesign 图层，并以显式保真报告导出同一受支持语义和已解析 Boolean 结果。

capabilities.provider: @opendesign/import-export-service SVG v1 + EditorRuntime planners + cancellable Renderer worker + Main path-free file bridge + run-scoped Agent import/export hosts + PathKit geometry

limitations.en: The File menu and Properties inspector import into an explicitly frozen Page/Frame/Group target and export frozen selected roots through a cancellable Renderer worker. The Agent imports only a run-scoped content-addressed SVG handle into explicit inspected local coordinates and exports inspected stable Page/root IDs through the same worker. Main validates authorization and Renderer results; the model receives neither SVG source nor local paths. macOS/Windows packaged-product smoke remains unavailable.
limitations.zh-CN: 文件菜单与属性检查器可把 SVG 导入冻结的 Page/Frame/Group 目标，并通过可取消 Renderer worker 导出冻结的显式选区根。Agent 只能把当前 Run 内容寻址的 SVG 句柄导入检查所得目标的明确局部坐标，并通过同一 worker 导出稳定 Page/root ID。Main 会校验授权与 Renderer 结果；模型既不接收 SVG 源码，也不接收本地路径。macOS/Windows 打包产品 smoke 仍待完成。

limitations.en: The current subset covers Frame/Group, rectangles, ellipses, directed Line/Arrow with controlled local endpoint markers, Path/Vector, controlled OpenDesign Text emitted as standard text/tspan content, transforms, solid and linear/radial gradients, center strokes, rounded Frame clipsContent, ordered alpha/luminance/outline/clipping sibling mask runs, up to eight normal zero-spread drop shadows, and one layer blur. Plain external line elements import as editable Lines; supported local userSpaceOnUse mask/clipPath references import as editable sibling mask groups. Fonts are not embedded and exact shaping, automatic wrapping, justify, ordinary third-party Text import, optional text outlines, images, arbitrary external marker definitions, root-level or combined mask+clip, objectBoundingBox clipPath, inner/background effects, glow, spread/blend, stylesheets, angular gradients, multiple-paint standard fidelity, complex filter graphs, and inside/outside stroke fidelity remain unavailable or explicitly degraded.
limitations.zh-CN: 当前子集覆盖 Frame/Group、Rectangle、Ellipse、带受控本地端点 marker 的有向 Line/Arrow、Path/Vector、以标准 text/tspan 输出的受控 OpenDesign Text、transform、纯色与线性/径向渐变、居中描边、圆角 Frame clipsContent、有序 alpha/luminance/outline/clipping 同级蒙版段、最多八个普通零 spread 投影和一层 layer blur；普通外部 line 会导入为可编辑 Line，受支持的本地 userSpaceOnUse mask/clipPath 引用会导入为可编辑同级蒙版组。字体不会嵌入，精确 shaping、自动换行、justify、普通第三方 Text 导入、可选文字轮廓、图片、任意外部 marker 定义、root-level 或 mask+clip 组合、objectBoundingBox clipPath、内阴影/背景效果、光晕、spread/blend、stylesheet、角度渐变、多 paint 标准保真、复杂 filter graph 与内外描边保真仍不可用或明确降级。

limitations.en: Standard SVG cannot retain OpenDesign Boolean operands. Export consumes a disposable resolved path, reports boolean-flattened, and re-imports it as an editable Vector without inventing lost source layers.
limitations.zh-CN: 标准 SVG 不能保留 OpenDesign Boolean operands；导出使用可丢弃 resolved path 并报告 boolean-flattened，重新导入为可编辑 Vector，不伪造已丢失的源层。

description.en: Export selected layers, Frames, or Slices to PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, or PDF with scale and transparency settings.
description.zh-CN: 按倍率和透明背景设置，把选中图层、Frame 或 Slice 导出为 PNG、JPEG、WebP、SVG 或 PDF。

capabilities.provider: DesignDocument 1.28.0 Slice/Export Settings + OpenDesign Raster Export v1 + leafer-editor 2.2.9 + Main RasterFileService; SVG v1 interchange service

limitations.en: Nodes persist ordered Figma-shaped export settings with suffixes. Human and Agent transactions can create real Slice nodes and set configurations; Slice raster delivery crops surrounding scene content through the same Leafer exporter. Canvas screenshots and dashed Slice overlays remain non-delivery projections.
limitations.zh-CN: 节点可持久保存带后缀的有序 Figma-shaped 导出配置。人工与 Agent 事务可创建真实 Slice 并设置配置；Slice 位图交付通过同一 Leafer 导出器裁切周围场景内容。画布截图和 Slice 虚线 overlay 仍是非交付投影。

limitations.en: Batch directory export, Page export, PDF, Display P3/ICC, Slice SVG crop, SVG text outlining and absolute/overlapping-content bounds are explicitly unsupported; WEBP is an OpenDesign extension rather than a Figma standard format.
limitations.zh-CN: 批量目录导出、整页导出、PDF、Display P3/ICC、Slice SVG 裁切、SVG 文字转轮廓及绝对/重叠内容边界均明确不支持；WEBP 是 OpenDesign 扩展，不冒充 Figma 标准格式。

limitations.en: Shared macOS/Windows path tests are complete; packaged-product save, overwrite, cancellation, transparency, and size smoke remain pending on both platforms.
limitations.zh-CN: macOS/Windows 共享路径自动化已完成；两平台打包产品的保存、覆盖、取消、透明与尺寸实测仍待完成。
